channel.title: Sameer — The Brief
channel.description: A daily morning news Brief for people who want the world clear before the day starts. India first, then the week’s decisive stories abroad — markets, politics, tech, and the forces that move them. Two anchors, eight to twelve minutes, no hot takes.

item.title: Sunday, September 27, 2026
item.description: Hormuz stays shut after Washington rejects Tehran’s seven-day reopen plan; Maharashtra’s drought declaration postpones cash relief; the Election Commission eases SIR notices and moves the claims clock; Greer’s product-level trade dump is due Monday. The midterms frame everything else.
